messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Does diag_pre_multiply() exist?
parts:
[cross-posted on stan-dev]

Good catch. I verified the problem exists with parsing
diag_pre_multiply in both 2.0.1 and on the develop branch.
So unless we squeeze in a last-minute fix, it will remain
broken in 2.1.0.

Here's the issue to track its being fixed:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/464

- Bob
